with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import os,re,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def bands(g,sepc):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    rs=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]==sepc]
    cs=[c for c in range(W) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and g[0][c]==sepc]
    rb=[];prev=0
    for s in rs+[H]:
        if s>prev+1: rb.append((prev,s-1))
        prev=s+1
    cb=[];prev=0
    for s in cs+[W]:
        if s>prev+1: cb.append((prev,s-1))
        prev=s+1
    return rs,cs,rb,cb
for k,sc in [('Demo pair 1',6),('Demo pair 2',2)]:
    gi,go=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']

    print(' rowbands',rb);print(' colbands',cb)
    # find changed cells
    ch=[(r,c,gi[r][c],go[r][c]) for r in range(len(gi)) for c in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]]
    print(' changed:',ch)

import os,glob,re,json,numpy as np
def load_all():
    out={}
    for sdir in glob.glob(os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])+'/../../sessions/*.jsonl'):
        t=open(sdir, encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore').read().replace('\\n','\n')
        for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
            k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
            rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
            if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
                if k not in out: out[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return out

print(po)

p=d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl'

ms=list(re.finditer(r'Test input \(26x23\):\n',t))

# check earlier message with grid blocks of other tasks in same file (each task appears as its own "instance"?)
print(sorted(set(re.findall(r'Test input \(\d+x\d+\)',t))))

    p=d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl'
    t=open(p, encoding='utf8', errors='replace').read().replace('\\n','\n')

        rows=[r.split() for r in m[4].strip().split('\n')]
        if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows): G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def bandmap(n):
    i=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; o=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(i),len(i[0])
    sr=[r for r in range(H) if len({x for x in i[r]})==1 and i[r][0]!=0]
    sc=[c for c in range(W) if len({i[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and i[0][c]!=0]
    rs=[]; prev=0
    for s in sr+[H]:
        if s>prev: rs.append((prev,s)); prev=s+1
    cs=[]; prev=0
    for s in sc+[W]:
        if s>prev: cs.append((prev,s)); prev=s+1
    sepc=i[sr[0]][sr[0]]
    print(f'--- demo {n}: bands={len(rs)} cols={len(cs)} sepcolor={sepc}')
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(rs):
        row=''
        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(cs):
            cells=tuple(sorted((r-r0,c-c0,i[r][c]) for r in range(r0+1,r1-1) for c in range(c0+1,c1-1) if i[r][c]!=0 and i[r][c]!=sepc))
            changed = any(o[r][c]!=i[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
            row+=f'b{ci}:{cells}{"CHANGED" if changed else ""}\n'
        print(' band',ri,row)
for n in [1,2]:
    bandmap(n)
